## Why visit

An outstanding combination of pub design, cask beer and cider, but outside the core Manchester–Liverpool itinerary. The curved bar, parquet floor and carefully restored 1930s/1950s details reward architecture enthusiasts; the operator’s enthusiasm for cider gives beer hunters a second reason to make the journey. It is the strongest Huddersfield anchor if you choose an eastern rail excursion, especially paired with the Rat & Ratchet. The travel cost is real in a five-day trip, so choose it as an alternative day rather than an extra stop after trying to cover every Manchester neighbourhood.

## Beer

CAMRA documents eight cask ales with local Mallinsons and dark styles regularly represented; beers change. CAMRA lists Timothy Taylor Boltmaker as regular and Mallinsons, Thornbridge and Vocation among the changing breweries.

## Cider and perry

**Real cider documented; reconfirm stock.** Operator explicitly promotes real cider; CAMRA documents changing ciders including regional makers and 2022–25 branch cider awards. CAMRA names ’Udders Orchard and Ross-on-Wye as changing real-cider makers; the exact product and perry stock require checking.

See [how cider is classified](../real-cider.md).
